You can star this repository to keep track of the project if it's helpful for you, thank you for your support. ## Major Features - **High Performance** The performance of re-implemented segmentation algorithms is better than or comparable to other codebases. - **Modular Design and Unified Benchmark** Various segmentation methods are unified into several specific modules. Benefiting from this design, SSSegmentation can integrate a great deal of popular and contemporary semantic segmentation frameworks and then, train and test them on unified benchmarks. - **Fewer Dependencies** SSSegmenation tries its best to avoid introducing more dependencies when reproducing novel semantic segmentation approaches. ## Benchmark and Model Zoo #### Supported Backbones |
